changelog:
feishu-ingest 1.0.3

- No code changes in this release.
- Documentation (SKILL.md) updated for improved clarity and structure.
- No changes to core logic, features, or configuration.
- Safe to upgrade; behavior is unchanged.
summary: Poll Feishu groups for new messages, download message resources, read Feishu docs/wiki/sheets/bitables, compile message-source markdown, judge which chat segments are worth preserving, and ingest valuable materials into the Research KB through a prepare/apply workflow.
